start.headline: Some families go quiet. That doesn't mean they've said no.
start.body: Here's how Banner Connect checks back in with families who stopped responding.

steps.alt: A pipeline card for the Johnson Family with a Cold tag
steps.title: A family goes cold
steps.body: The Johnson Family asked about your school, then nothing. After a stretch with no contact, their card gets a Cold tag.

steps.alt: The Cold Inquiry Revival workflow with four emails and waits between them
steps.title: Four check-ins over two weeks
steps.body: The Cold tag starts a short series: four emails spaced 3, 4 and 7 days apart. If the family replies, your team takes it from there.

steps.alt: Cold Inquiry Revival email #1 with the subject Still thinking about the school
steps.title: Short, personal and easy to answer
steps.body: "Still thinking about our school?" It's signed by your admissions director and asks one simple question. Parents just hit reply.

finish.headline: Families who went quiet get a second chance.
finish.body: And your team doesn't have to remember who to chase.
